items.summaryShort: Uber Builds GitFarm to Run Git Operations as a Service for Large-Scale Monorepos. Uber’s GitFarm provides Git operations as a centralized service, eliminating local repository clones across large scale monorepo workloads.

items.summaryShort: An Anthropic researcher just gave us a peek at self-improving AI. Given 10 benchmarks for specific misaligned behaviors, the automated systems were able to improve performance on every single one without degrading overall performance.

items.title: Brave's browser one-ups Chrome with its new support for email aliases
items.summaryShort: Brave's browser one-ups Chrome with its new support for email aliases. The feature, announced this week, allows Brave's users to sign up for websites and other online services without having to share their personal email addresses.
